company.name: Rekursiv AI
company.shortDescription: Rekursiv AI develops autonomous systems that hypothesize, perform research, and design machine learning experiments.
company.description: Rekursiv AI develops autonomous AI research systems that form hypotheses, design and run experiments, interpret results, and produce technical discoveries. Its research platform coordinates fleets of AI scientists, assigns evaluation tasks, supports peer review, and traces claims to evidence. The company also publishes open-source software, including sagent, a typed Python API and command-line interface for building coding agents, and Copybarista, a tool for synchronizing packages between private repositories or monorepos and public repositories.
